programme.title: WWII: On the Edge of the Abyss
programme.desc: The war reaches new levels of intensity as it drags on, affecting civilian populations like never before. The concept of 'total war' becomes reality, with cities bombed into oblivion, resources stretched to their limits, and entire societies mobilized for the war effort. Strategic bombing campaigns against Germany and Japan begin to devastate industrial centers and civilian morale alike.

programme.title: The SS and The Occult
programme.desc: This powerful film revisits the sites most closely associated with Heinrich Himmler and traces the development of his warped ideology. Heinrich Himmler was the creator of the infamous Gestapo, the Waffen SS and the concentration camp network. He was inspired by mystic visions, runes, horoscopes and a longing for a heroic German past. The occult roots of the Third Reich are discussed.

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: This episode examines the relations between the United States, the Philippines, and Japan prior to World War II. Then it focuses on the Japanese invasion of Luzon, the take-over of Manila, and the eventual attack and seizure of Corregidor.

programme.title: Grey Wolves Part 3: The End of the Dream
programme.desc: Winston Churchill anxiously followed the victories and defeats of the U-Boats in the atlantic. After the war had ended, he admitted that the U-Boat threat had been the one thing that truly scared him during the entire War. Despite the terrible loses inflicted on the fleets, young boys were still attracted to the submarines.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: It fell to the Russians to enter Berlin first, and as Hitler took his own life in his bunker, the war in Europe finally came to an end. Winston Churchill led the people of Britain in the VE Day celebrations, but the fighting continued in the Pacific.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: With Europe sifting through the rubble of a long and bitter war, the Japanese refused to surrender. A long land campaign was too high a price to pay. Truman took the decision to end WWII swiftly, with the nuclear bombing of Hiroshima and Nagasaki.

programme.title: Complete History of Air Combat
programme.desc: Explore the role played by the 101st Airborne Division during Normandy. On June 5, General Dwight Eisenhower delivered a rousing speech intended to boost the morale of the division and help make them pivotal in the success of the invasion.

programme.title: Memories of a Nazi Camp
programme.desc: The Natzweiler-Struthof camp has been erased from historical memory and yet.. with one of the highest death rate, this Nazi camp saw the worst eXactions and scientific eXperiences of the history.

programme.title: Complete History of Air Combat
programme.desc: A closer look at the scope of the U.S air power during the Vietnam war. See how air power changed the war, from bomb showers by the Republic F-105 Thunderchief, to C-123 Providers crashing, intended to supply provisions and air lift soldiers and civilians.
programme.sub-title: Vietnam and the Limits of Strategic Bombing

programme.title: War Machines
programme.desc: When humans took to the skies, they brought war with them. This episode traces aerial combat from WWI dogfights to bombers, jets, and drones. Exploring how air power evolved into one of the deadliest forces in warfare, it highlights the relentless drive to fly faster, strike harder, and control the skies-forever changing the face of battle from above.

programme.title: War in the Pacific
programme.desc: The Marines hoist the flag after a bloody victory at Iwo Jima.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Vietnam War
programme.desc: This program is a unique examination of the history of courage among American fighting men and of the Medal of Honor which was developed in tribute to that quality. We examine the American revolutionary times, the Civil War, the War of 1812, the Indian War, the Spanish-American War, the two world wars, and the Korean and Vietnam conflicts. The host of the film is John Daly.

programme.title: Wings of Destruction
programme.desc: Both sides utilized air power during the Vietnam War, but the United States ruled the skies. The American pilots often were the factors that turned the fortunes of battles by interrupting enemy supply lines and communications, as well as gathering reconnaissance information for the ground troops. Despite the overwhelming success, it didn't produce victory. Vietnam air tactics broke the prior mold.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: In spite of spring and rain our ground forces continue to push back the Chinese all along the Eighth Army's front...The 25th Infantry Division crosses the Han River and U.N. forces reach the 38th Parallel. The program includes two interviews: The first with Sergeant William Taylor who was a mortar squad leader with the 24th Division. The other is with Lieutenant Charles Wright of Oneonta, Alabama.
programme.sub-title: Big Picture: The United Nations Offensive Continues

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: Crusade in the Pacific looks at the brutal effort to take the Palau islands. On Peleliu, U.S. forces encounter fierce fighting from well fortified and entrenched Japanese soldiers. The U.S. eventually push the Japanese back to Bloody Nose Ridge where some of the bloodiest fighting on the war takes place. After weeks of fighting, the Allies finally secure the island.
programme.sub-title: Palau: The Fight for Bloody Nose Ridge

programme.title: WWII In Color: D-Day to Nazi Downfall
programme.desc: After six months of retreat across Northern Europe, Adolf Hitler's forces on the Western Front are back behind Germany's borders. For the Allies the war seems almost over, as they pause to plan for the final drive to Berlin. But The Fuhrer has other plans - he has one last unexpected card to play.

programme.title: Soviet Storm
programme.desc: After the failure to take both Moscow and Leningrad, Hitler sets his sights on the oil fields in the Caucasus. If captured, the Red Army will lose 70-90% of all its oil resources. Therefore, the famous city on the Volga, Stalingrad, must be 'held at all costs.' The German General Staff thinks taking the city will be a matter of a few weeks, but events steadily turn against the Germans.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: Amateur filmmakers in Normandy secretly documented daily life between 1939-1945, risking arrest under Nazi rule. Preserved for decades, their footage reveals war's darkest hours-shortages, fear, and ruins-yet also family bonds, joy, and hope. This documentary offers an extraordinary civilian perspective, intertwining anonymous lives with the unfolding tragedy and liberation of WWII.

programme.title: Fighter Aircraft: The Quest For Speed
programme.desc: The rare combination to power and grace lends high performance aircraft a fascination all their own. Hurdling through the atmosphere at extraordinary velocities they traverse oceans and continents, accomplishing in a few hours what journeys would cost in painful labor and time. Making these airplanes faster has been a long endeavor in fuel and technology. One element remains constant - pilots.

programme.title: The Crusade in Europe
programme.desc: This installment talks about the lessons learned, both military and diplomatic, about coalition warfare. It includes a reenactment of the Alamogordo atomic bomb test, as well as its use against Japan.

programme.title: The Bomber: Terror of World War II
programme.desc: Tokyo's firebombing proved deadly-wood and paper homes made cities burn fast. The B-29 bomber and napalm upped the carnage. In Europe, USAAF and RAF bombed day and night. New tech like bunker busters and bouncing bombs made targets harder to hide. The bomber was now war's most fearsome force.

programme.title: Great Tank Battles
programme.desc: The fourth episode sees the Germans well and truly on the retreat and the Allies are able to successfully implement operation Husky - the landing on Sicily - where General Montgomery and the American General George Smith Patton ousted the Germans in little over five weeks. On the Eastern Front General Zhukov inflicted heavy defeat on the Germans now having the new T - 54 tank available.

programme.title: Stalin's Executioners: The Katyn Massacre
programme.desc: This film tells for the first time the story of the Katyn massacre seen from both sides: That of the victims and that of the perpetrators. It reveals how this crime, attributed to the Nazis for 50 years, was in fact carried out by the Soviet secret police, the NKVD.

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: With recolorized archives, this episode explores the final year of Hitler's infamous division. From recruitment and indoctrination to their last missions, we uncover who these men were-and how they became perpetrators of mass murder. Following their brutal combat and crimes against humanity, we confront the chaos, ideology, and horror that defined the Das Reich's final descent.
programme.sub-title: Hitler's Death Army - Part II: Death and Decline

programme.title: War Machines
programme.desc: The 20th century saw a deadly leap in technology. This episode explores mankind's most fearsome creations-chemical, atomic, robotic, and nuclear weapons. From banned gases to bombs that level cities, it's the story of ultimate destruction. Some were used, others were not-but all redefined the scale of warfare and the terrifying potential of future conflicts.

programme.title: Baby Cages: The Denazification Of Hitler Youth
programme.desc: In a final insane attempt to turn the tide of the war, Hitler recruited from the Hitler Youth, enlisting children as young as 12 years old. Around 10,000 of these young fighters, who were both persecutors and victims, would be taken prisoner by the Americans. A re-education program started at Attichy Camp to steer them towards an attitude of tolerance and democracy. It was called 'Baby Cages'.

programme.title: The Amazing World of War Machines
programme.desc: Beneath the waves lurks a stealthy war machine. Capable of carrying nuclear weapons, submarines play a key role in the defense of many countries around the world today. The earliest beginnings of submarines can be traced back to the time of Alexander the Great in 323 B.C. In 1776 American inventor David Bushnell designed and constructed the first military submarine.

programme.title: The Night of the Long Knives: Hitler's Rise to Power
programme.desc: The Night of the Long Knives is considered the first act of horror committed by the Nazis. What happened in Germany, and in Hitler's rise to power, that led to this purge in 1934? Caught between the conservative tendency and the revolutionary aspirations that were dividing the country, the Chancellor had a choice. To calm the rumors of a military coup against him, Hitler sent a clear message.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: Meet Jose Lopez, a man who can forage chicken from deserted farms and cook it, a la Mexican, but also a fighting man. Watch him prove himself, carrying weapons and ammunition through enemy fire, firing his machine gun with deadly accuracy, holding off almost singlehandedly a deadly attack. Watch this Laredo, Texas, born-and-bred soldier earn the nation's highest award and the nickname, 'Tex'.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: In mid-August 1944, the Allies launched 'Operation Anvil' to increase pressure on German troops after the Normandy landings. The 517th Airborne was tasked with preventing enemy tanks from reaching the beachhead. This episode recounts the story of three American sergeants and a British major who jumped into enemy territory, successfully completed their mission, and survived to tell the tale.

programme.desc: In this third film of the series, '1941', see how Adolf Hitler increased the Nazi stranglehold on Europe, while Winston Churchill inspired the people of Britain to stand together as the nightly Luftwaffe bombing raids were extended to include the nation's vital ports, as well as the capital, London.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: From the moment Adolf Hitler marched his troops into Poland on the 1st of September 1939, the Second World War was inevitable. As the opening skirmishes are played out, see for yourself the events that shaped the escalating crisis.

Finally, Lidia will share her Fusilli with Roasted Tomato Pesto - a complex bowl of pasta that will become a staple in your house.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

As simple as it was, there is nothing that could take away how powerful this culinary experience was for her. Lidia starts off with a quick and easy Onion Tomato Focaccia, and then talks about Taralli, crunchy little bread rings that are a treat in southern Italy. She then makes Pizza Rolls with two uniquely Italian fillings- broccoli rabe and sausage, and ricotta and leeks.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

Served with a Tasty Potato Salad and finished with beautiful Almond and Coffee Cream Mini Tarts, this is a meal that everyone will love!

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

Tuna Salad with Boiled Zucchini, String Bean Salad with Capers and Basil, Whole Wheat Cous with Cucumbers, and finally Shells with Chicken and Zucchini.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

Next, she prepares a Baked Eggplant Stuffed with Meat and Vegetables, topped with a golden, cheesy crust. Her unique version of Baked Potatoes is made with Pancetta and Oregano.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

Veal Stew with Onion and Squash is the perfect one-pot meal, in which the protein and vegetables come together.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

She'll also show you how to prepare an easy dessert spread with seasonal fruits and a few store-bought sweet Italian specialties.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Italian cuisine is known for seasonal ingredients and simple techniques. In today's episode, Lidia will share recipes that master simplicity: Sausages with Fennel & Olives; Orange and Red Salad and a delicious "Almost a Tiramisu" recipe.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

In this episode, Lidia prepares a filling meal of Potato and Pasta Soup followed by Polenta with Honey and Berries, an easy way to use leftover polenta.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.desc: Fried potatoes with sausage and eggs; breakfast risotto featuring bacon, egg and cheese; ricotta pancakes.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Lidia prepares a colourful summer panzanella with roasted zucchini and onions, and a warm shrimp and squash ribbon salad.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen
programme.desc: Citrus and fennel salad; crispy smashed garlic rosemary potatoes; roast pork shoulder.

Lidia's Potato and Egg Frico - a crispy Asiago cheese crust made with potatoes and eggs is always a winner at the brunch table.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

Finally, it's time for a light and airy Almond Tart from Andria.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen

She then gets on videochat with her grandson, Lorenzo, for an Asparagus Gratin Topped with Fried Egg. Her Clam Soup is perfect for a weeknight dinner!

programme.title: Basmati Blues
programme.desc: When a young scientist learns she has unwittingly aided a destructive plan against the Indian farmers she was supposedly sent to help, she teams up with a local farmer to save the day.

programme.title: Breakfast of Champions
programme.desc: An unhappy car dealer (Bruce Willis) believes that a dime-store author/philosopher (Albert Finney) has the answers to life's important questions.

programme.title: Shade
programme.desc: Tiffany (Jamie Foxx), Charlie (Gabriel Byrne) and Vernon (Thandie Newton) are con artists looking to up the ante from their typical scams. They figure a good way of doing this is taking down Dean "The Dean" Stevens (Dina Merrill), a well-known cardsharp, in a rigged game. However, they first need enough money to enter a game with Stevens, so they decide to strike a deal with fellow crook Larry Jennings (Stuart Townsend) to scam a local gangster -- which turns out to be a bad idea.

programme.title: The Crush
programme.desc: Writer Nick Eliot moves to a new city for a magazine job and rents a room in the house of Cliff and Liv Forrester, whose 14-year-old daughter, Adrian, instantly makes her attraction to Nick clear. While Nick romances photographer Amy Maddik at work, he has trouble fending off Adrian's advances. As her obsession with Nick grows, Adrian becomes angry at being rejected and starts attacking his property and friends.

programme.title: Starcrash
programme.desc: A space explorer and his girlfriend try to protect Earth from devastation.

programme.title: Black Sabbath
programme.desc: Karloff introduces tales of a haunted nurse (Jacqueline Pierreux), a stalked call-girl (Michèle Mercier) and a vampire (Boris Karloff).

programme.desc: Kiba is back again, but this time he has fallen from grace and been sent to prison for all the violent acts he has committed. Once he's out, he begins working as a bodyguard in a club that is crawling with gangsters.

programme.title: Emmet Otter's Jug-Band Christmas
programme.desc: Emmet and Ma Otter are very poor, but they are very happy and talented singers. Christmas is around the corner, and they both want to get the other a very special present. The prize in the talent show is $50. Both Emmet and Ma get a song ready for the competition; Emmet forms a jug band, and Ma practices alone, to vie with the Riverbottom Gang.

programme.title: The Devil Bat
programme.desc: Dr. Paul Carruthers (Bela Lugosi) is frustrated because he thinks his employers, Mary Heath (Suzanne Kaaren) and Henry Morton (Guy Usher), have cheated him out of the company's profits. He decides to get revenge by altering bats to grow twice their normal size and training them to attack when they smell a perfume of his own making. He mixes the perfume into a lotion, which he offers as a gift to Mary and Henry. When they turn up dead, a newspaper reporter (Dave O'Brien) decides to investigate.

programme.title: Legacy of Rage
programme.desc: Sentenced to prison for a crime he did not commit, a man sets out for revenge after his release from jail.

programme.title: The Blob
programme.desc: A drive-in favorite, this sci-fi classic follows teenagers Steve (Steven McQueen) and his best girl, Jane (Aneta Corseaut), as they try to protect their hometown from a gelatinous alien life form that engulfs everything it touches. The first to discover the substance and live to tell about it, Steve and Jane witness the blob destroying an elderly man and grow to a terrifying size. But no one else has seen the goo, and policeman Dave (Earl Rowe) refuses to believe the kids without proof.

programme.title: FernGully ... the Last Rainforest
programme.desc: Crysta is a fairy who lives in FernGully, a rainforest in Australia, and has never seen a human before. In fact, she is told they are extinct. But when a logging company comes near the rainforest, she sees that they do exist, and even accidentally shrinks one of them: a boy named Zak. Now her size, Zak sees the damage that the company does and helps Crysta to stop not only them, but an evil entity named Hexxus, who feeds off pollution.

programme.title: Pacific Heights
programme.desc: Unmarried yuppies Patty (Melanie Griffith) and Drake (Matthew Modine) move into an expensive dream home in a high-end neighborhood in San Francisco. As they renovate the house, they look for a tenant for the first floor of their house. Carter Hayes (Michael Keaton) seems like a great fit at first, but it transpires that he is a con artist who plans to swindle them out of their real estate. As Hayes tries to drive them out of their own home, the couple must take drastic measures to fight back.

programme.title: Shark Night
programme.desc: Newly arrived at her family's lake-island cabin, college student Sara (Sara Paxton) and her friends prepare for a weekend of fun in the sun. But soon after they dive into the lake, football player Malik (Sinqua Walls) stumbles out of the water with a grievous wound. Thinking Malik is the victim of a freak accident, the friends pile into a tiny speedboat and head for the hospital. To their horror, they discover that they are surrounded by hundreds of massive, hungry sharks.

programme.title: Funny Games
programme.desc: An idyllic lakeside vacation home is terrorized by Paul (Arno Frisch) and Peter (Frank Giering), a pair of deeply disturbed young men. When the fearful Anna (Susanne Lothar) is home alone, the two men drop by for a visit that quickly turns violent and terrifying. Husband Georg (Ulrich Mühe) comes to her rescue, but Paul and Peter take the family hostage and subject them to nightmarish abuse and humiliation. From time to time, Paul talks to the film's audience, making it complicit in the horror.

programme.title: Hotel Artemis
programme.desc: As rioting rocks Los Angeles in the year 2028, disgruntled thieves make their way to Hotel Artemis -- a 13-story, members-only hospital for criminals. It's operated by the Nurse, a no-nonsense, high-tech healer who already has her hands full of a French assassin, an arms dealer and an injured cop. As the violence of the night continues, the Nurse must decide whether to break her own rules and confront what she's worked so hard to avoid.

He's taking on two newcomers: Dan Fletcher, protégé of Phil Howard, and now head chef at 'Fenchurch' in the City of London, and David Coulson, who runs 'Peace and Loaf' in Newcastle, which boasts 2 AA rosettes.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: After a tense starter course the chefs are all aiming for 10s with their unique fish dishes. David is celebrating a personal connection to the brief with his `My Cod I Bet Me Ma'am Has Seen Some Trotters', a tribute to his mum who has worked as a chiropodist. Dan's `For All Those Sleepless Nights' pays tribute to night shift workers from the NHS with some bold but classic flavours while Danny's `Not All Superheroes Wear Capes' aims to give a taste of luxury to the hardworking staff.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Dan pays tribute to an icon of modern nursing, Florence Nightingale, while Danny is inspired by the founder of the NHS, Aneurin Bevan. David's dish is dedicated to the air ambulance staff who saved the life of his fiancé, and he even takes a trip to meet one of them.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the chefs' last chance to impress and tensions are high. Dan takes a risk with an unusual combination of ewe's milk and bergamot while Danny is determined to pull out all the stops with his complex dessert `Aunty Gwen's Chocolate'. David hopes to transform a childhood comfort classic into a show stopping dessert. Dan also takes a trip to meet Dr Ben Clarke who was working in the Royal London Hospital A&E during the London Bridge terror attack.

programme.title: Great British Menu

programme.title: Great British Menu

And Selin is taking a risk with a complex three-part fish dish featuring sardines, scallops and langoustines, as a nod to the purported health benefits of a Mediterranean diet.

programme.desc: Scott is showcasing rare-breed Tamworth pork to say thank you to the rare breed of people who work for the NHS. programme.title: Great British Menu

Scott hopes his elevated gypsy tart 'Honey Bee Good' will secure him a place in the final.

programme.title: Great British Menu

programme.title: Great British Menu

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the dessert course and the last opportunity for the chefs to impress. Which two will make it through to the judging chamber?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It is the Wales regional final as the two remaining chefs do everything they can to impress the judging panel of Andi Oliver, Matthew Fort and Oliver Peyton. After tensions ran high in the week, the chefs are under pressure to deliver perfection. The judges are joined by Aneira Thomas, the first baby born on the NHS, who is named in tribute to the service's founder Aneurin Bevan and who went on to dedicate her life to the service. Jude is attempting a complex fusion dish featuring four different fish and an unusual X-Ray themed presentation, while Olivia is paying tribute to the staff who looked after her during the birth of her first son with her take on curried monkfish.

programme.title: Great British Menu

Olivia is hoping her dish, using two unusual cuts of beef, will score top points. Olivia also visits her local children's hospital, home of the second-busiest paediatric A&E in the country.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: With just one more chance to impress their veteran judge, the chefs are all hoping to use their pastry skills to deliver technically complex desserts. Tom's cooking an 'Invalid Fruit Tart' inspired by a 1950s recipe, while Jude is making six different apple elements for his 'An Apple A Day'. Olivia is using stout in reference to an outdated old wives' tale which suggested the drink was a healthy source of iron during pregnancy.

programme.title: Great British Menu

The judges are joined by Barbara Childs, a Matron in the Cardiac Intensive Care Unit at Great Ormond Street Hospital, who isn't afraid to speak her mind in the chamber.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Three chefs take to the kitchen in a bid to represent the north-west in the national final. They include Ellis Barrie, from the award-winning Marram Grass in Anglesey, Liam Simpson-Trotman, an accomplished pastry chef and co-owner of the 4 AA rosette Orwell's in Oxfordshire, and Craig Sherrington, who sharpened his skills working under top names including Eric Chavot and is now Chef Patron of Virginia House in Cumbria.

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: It's the fish course and the chefs are all gunning for tens. Craig pays tribute to a friend who has revolutionised hospital food in Morecambe Bay, while Liam is inspired by health advice his grandma gave him and Ellis is dedicating his dish to the staff who delivered his son Albert. With cod, mackerel, shrimp and cockles on the menu, which of the chefs will score highly?

programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: Time for the chefs to cook their mains and the pressure is on. Craig is hoping to impress using two cuts of Dexter beef, while Liam prepares his take on a Bajan lamb stew and Ellis prepares four cuts of suckling pig. Liam meets his personal hero, Nola Ishmael OBE, who became the UK's first ever black Director of Nursing.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team is invited to Lemp Mansion in St. Louis, Missouri. There have been tragic deaths at this mansion with the patriarch and three of his children taking their own lives. There are reported feelings of uneasiness in 'the office,' which is where William Lemp committed suicide. The bar area was once the bedroom of Charles Lemp, who killed his dog and then himself it's said that people see him walking around with his dog at his side.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is asked to investigate the abandoned Milton School in Alton, Ill. where some students are said to still be walking through the halls. In the 1930's a young student named Mary was killed at the school, and the janitor who was the prime suspect then committed suicide inside the building. There are claims that people feel a child holding their hand and smell bubble gum.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Ohio and to the Thurber house, the home of author James Thurber, who wrote The Night the Ghost Got In based off his paranormal experiences there. The house's history is checkered; for starters, it was built on top of where an insane asylum once stood. Seven women died - a man killed his wife and then himself. Lights turn themselves on and off, people have seen apparitions and heard footsteps, and a clock spontaneously comes to life.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters TAPS returns to Mansfield, Ohio to investigate the Bissman Building, where the current manager, Ellis Byrd, was nearly choked to death by a black mist. The Bissman Building has been in his family for five generations, and has its fair share of paranormal activity. Many believe the activity started in 1911 following a violent death where an employee was decapitated by the building's elevator.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS starts out at the Ulster County Jail in Kingston, NY, where inmates and personal have both witnessed activity. The claims there range from objects moving on their own to ghosts talking to people. A ghost with hollowed out eyes and long white hair confronted a guard, and another guard was poked in the head by one of the spirits.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, Taps heads to Beardslee Castle in Little Falls, NY, which is a home turned into a restaurant/ bar that has lots of interesting claims. Some of these claims include screams, voices, doors opening, singing, and a lady who forms standing next to a window. Steve and Grant get started on the door that opens on its own in the kitchen. Steve starts to open a nearby door and sure enough, the other door opens forcefully as well. Debunked!
programme.sub-title: Home is Where the Haunt Is

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, Taps heads to Fort William Henry located in Lake George, New York, where Ghost Hunters Academy winner Adam Berry joins the team. Before the team heads out, we learn that Kris and Britt will be joining the GHI team and heading to Eastern Europe. The fort was built in 1755. During the French and Indian War, local Native American tribes defeated the British, killing over 1,000 people.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson are two plumbers working for Roto-Rooter in New England. They are also the co-founders of TAPS - The Atlantic Paranormal Society - a paranormal research team which investigates hauntings and other strange occurrences.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads south to Atlanta, Georgia to investigate Rhodes Hall, where they will be joined by the stars of the Real Housewives of Atlanta, NeNe Leakes, Sheree Whitfield, and Kim Zolciak. Traci Clark, the Hall's communications director, tells the team about the history and the activity that has been reported. Amos Rhodes built the home in 1904, and his family resided there for 20 years, before Amos passed away in the home.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS gets into the Christmas spirit at New Hampshire's Christmas Farm Inn. Gary Plourde, the owner, gives the guys the tour and shares some of the reported activity. The stories range from apparitions and footsteps, to the sounds of children playing and the feeling of being watched. Jason and Grant start out the night in the Carriage House spa and start to hear some footsteps around them.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS investigates the entire town of Alexandria, Louisiana, where paranormal activity seems to lurk around every corner. The first stop on their paranormal tour is the Hotel Bentley, where among other reports, disembodied conversations are heard, and a little girl trips people on the stairs. The next stop is Finnegan's Wake Tavern, where there are reports of shadows moving, loud bangs coming from upstairs, and a glass breaking on its own.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Chester County, Pennsylvania to investigate the Pennhurst Asylum. Pennhurst was forcibly shut down in 1986 for mistreatment of patients, overcrowding and abuse. Some of the claims are screams being heard, people being pushed, doors opening and closing on their own, shadows, and apparitions.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Oxford, Massachusetts to help a family in need. The house has been in the Voas family for two generations, and lots of activity has been reported, from apparitions and shadow figures to footsteps and conversations. A braid of hair and shoe were also found in the basement during renovations.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to America's most haunted city, New Orleans, to investigate the Old U.S. Mint. This mint-turned-museum has lots of reported activity, including shadow figures, thuds, noises, female apparitions, lights flickering and alarms going off. Steve and Tango start off their night on the second floor. While the guys are walking around a door suddenly opens and then slams shut all on its own, leaving the guys speechless.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode on Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to South Dakota for the first time to investigate the Alex Johnson Hotel, a place filled with history. Some of the paranormal activity reported are apparitions, voices, objects being moved, growling sounds, and a story of a bride to be either being killed or committing suicide. The TAPS team also welcomes Maddie, the ghost-hunting dog.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Jason Hawes and Grant Wilson are two plumbers working for Roto-Rooter in New England. They are also the co-founders of TAPS - The Atlantic Paranormal Society - a paranormal research team which investigates hauntings and other strange occurrences.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Prospect, Maine to investigate Fort Knox, built before the Civil War to protect the Penobscot narrows. Some of the reported activity has been sounds of stones skipping, doors opening, apparitions, and a strong feeling of evil being felt. Britt is back with the TAPS team and the guys get set up. Jason and Grant start in Long Alley, and the guys see something strange appear on the thermal camera.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels to Worcester, Massachusetts to investigate the Higgins Armory, the only armory in the western hemisphere devoted to arms and armor. Some of the activity that has been reported is loud knocking, banging, footsteps, music, doors opening/closing, and the apparition of the former owner. Jason and Grant get started in the Quest Gallery, and they see a chain moving on its own.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, Taps heads to Derby, Connecticut to investigate one of the country's oldest Opera houses, the Sterling Opera House. Some of the reported paranormal activity is a woman in white, as well as a gentleman in a period suit, and shadows. Some believe the Opera House's builder Charles Sterling haunts it, because he died two years before the building was complete.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS travels for the first time to Hawaii to investigate the Pacific Aviation Museum at Pearl Harbor in Honolulu. Steve can't fly, so he isn't able to make the trip, but Britt is helping out, as well as Destination Truth's Josh Gates. Some of the activity that has been reported is whispers, cold air being felt, apparitions, and cameras being turned on and off on command.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Last time on Ghost Hunters, the team was in Hawaii investigating the Pacific Aviation Museum with special guest Josh Gates, when Steve called Jason with an urgent personal case back in Rhode Island that involves a terrified 4 year old. Jason and Grant hop the first flight back, and meet up with Steve at TAPS headquarters to get the low down on this next case. While there they conference in to do the reveal back in Hawaii with Tango and Amy.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team travels to New Castle, Pennsylvania to investigate Hill View Manor. Before closing in 2004, this old nursing facility had many reports of death by suicide. Some of the paranormal claims by staff members includes unexplained reflections, voices, full body apparitions, shadow figures, the sounds of machines, and people seeing a little boy known as Jeffrey. After seeing Jeffrey, the patients would soon pass away.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS becomes the first paranormal group to investigate Seaview Terrace in Newport, RI. Built in 1923 by the Bradley family, Seaview Terrace is recognizable from TV's "Dark Shadows" which filmed there in the 1960's. Some of the reported activity includes an apparition of Mrs. Bradley, voices, feelings of being watched, seeing faces, and the temperature fluctuating. Jason and Grant start out in the Great Hall and try to get Mrs.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Townsend, Massachusetts to investigate the Townsend Historical Society's two houses; the Reed Homestead and the Spaulding Cooperage. The main goal is to help staff not be afraid of paranormal activity that seems to be taking place at both properties. Built in 1809, the Reed Homestead was home to four generations of the Oliver Reed family. One of Oliver Reed's four daughters, Hannah, hanged herself after the death of her young daughter.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to the Carnegie Library Homestead, in Homestead, Pennsylvania. This Library was the site of violent riots between Carnegie and the steel workers. It is said that Carnegie built the library to win the steel workers over. It is thought that steel workers or Carnegie himself could be haunting the building. Some of the reported activity includes shadow figures, books falling off shelves, apparitions, and voices.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Hawaii's Plantation Village, which was once a sugar plantation. It it is now an outdoor museum with reports of spirits still wandering the property and the many authentically replicated homes. It is believed that some of the entities seen are those who committed suicide or were murdered.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS and Jason's daughter, Haily, head to Napanoch, New York to investigate the Shanley Hotel. Since its opening in 1845, The Shanley Hotel has been plagued by an abundance of inexplicable deaths and tragic events targeting children. One of these tragic stories involved a little girl named Rosie, who died as she fell down a well while playing with friends. Some of the reports are of apparitions and toys moving in various rooms of the hotel.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS becomes the first paranormal team to ever investigate the historic Friars Club in New York City. Built in 1904 and famous for its roasts, TAPS has been brought in to find out if comedian, Al Kelly, is behind all the activity. There have been reports that an old man can be heard grunting, cold air surrounding someone, lockers moving, shadows, and apparitions of a man sitting at a table.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Niagara Falls, NY to investigate paranormal activity that has been reported at Rapids Theater. Claims revolve around an actress who is said to have hanged herself backstage. People have heard the sound of high heels, whistling, doors opening and closing on their own and apparitions have being seen around the stage and bar areas.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Snug Harbor, in Staten Island, New York. The team is very excited to be joined by Meredith Vieira, who will help them investigate this large property that includes historic landmark buildings. The investigation focuses on a lady in white who has been seen floating throughout Snugs Harbor. She is believed to be a laundry worker, known as a Matron, who was murdered by her thirteen year old son, who she kept chained inthe basement.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is called out to Jefferson City, Missouri to investigate Missouri State penitentiary. Having opened in 1836,it stood as oneof the oldest and most violent prisons in America, and was referred to as "the bloodiest 47 acres". While still operational, both guards and inmates reported strange experiences at the penitentiary. It continued even after its doorsclosed. Some of the activity reportedincludes apparitions of men and women, doors slamming, and footsteps.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads back to the fan favorite, Waverly Hills Sanatorium in Louisville, Kentucky, where more activity has been reported and a nurse's wing has been opened up for TAPS to explore. The activity reported includes solid dark shadows and voices. Stave and Tango start out their night in the Death Tunnel where they hear sounds, and loud slams, but can't figure out what caused it.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to one of the oldest distilleries in America, Buffalo Trace, in Frankfort, Kentucky. Operating since the 18th century, its former president, Colonel Blanton, is believed to still be roaming the buildings. He worked and lived at the distillery for over 55 years, before passing away at his home, which was on the property.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called out to Hartford, CT to Elks Lodge, the oldest and largest secret fraternal organizations in the country. Elks Lodge #19 is shrouded in mystery and tragedy with a gruesome death hanging over its head....and decades of paranormal activity. Next they head to Morse Mill Hotel, in Morse Mill, Missouri - a hotel with a violent past. They are called in to help a client who is dealing with threatening spirits that emerged as renovations began.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Ohio to investigate Kings Island, an amusement park that sits on land that was the site of an awful accident. The workers here believe the people who died in the accident could be the ones still visiting the park. Some of the reported activity includes the sound of laughter, footsteps, objects being thrown, and a girl in a little blue dress who is said to be the ghost of a child buried in the nearby cemetery.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Naples, New York, to investigate the Naples Hotel. This hotel was built in 1895. There was a suicide at the hotel in the 1920's, which is when the activity is said to begin. The owners believe the ghost of the victim is still there and have nicknamed him "Topper." Some of the reported activity includes apparitions, voices, and objects being thrown.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS heads to Hales Bar Dam and Marina in Tennessee, to investigate a dam that was built on Native American land. It is believed that a Cherokee chief cursed this property after he was forced off it. Due to numerous problems, Hales Bar Dam took eight years to complete and was finally finished in 1907. During the building of this dam there were many tragedies such as accidental deaths, including workers being buried alive in cement walls.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS investigates a 19th century Bed and Breakfast in Red Boiling Springs, Tennessee, built by the Cloyd family. Over the years, many members of the Cloyd family passed away at this property. The current owners, the Coles, believe the Cloyds never left and are haunting the hotel. People have seen several full body apparitions, matching the descriptions of various Cloyd members. Whistling has been heard, a lady in pink has been seen as well as a man in black.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Wythe County, Virginia to answer a call for help at one of the town's most feared houses - The Graham Mansion. This foreboding, twenty-five room home has witnessed a twisted history of evil through the centuries starting with a slave owner in the 1700's who was murdered by his two slaves. In the 1800's, Squire David Graham purchased the home. His wife suffered from mental illness and was locked-up in the basement.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS, minus Grant, answers a call for help from Providence City Hall where paranormal activity is threatening the staff. And now there is also concern for the hundreds of citizens who pass through this building every day. Built in 1878, this prominent building has the city's history tucked away between its walls, including a ghostly former mayor who is refusing to leave office...even when on the other side.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads out to investigate the U.S. Naval Institute in Annapolis, Maryland, where a marine's death remains a mystery and his ghost still roams the property.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Grant's final case draws near, but that doesn't stop the TAPS team from helping those in need. They head to Mount Joy, Pennsylvania to investigate Bube's Brewery to see if the late owner, Alois Bube, and his deceased family members are still presiding over the lager business. Alois purchased the brewery in 1876 and added on a Victorian hotel to serve his beer and accommodate overnight guests.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: Grant's last show draws even closer, but in the meantime the cases keep coming, and this one is very exciting for the whole team; the USS Yorktown in Mt. Pleasant, South Carolina. This is an 872-foot warship, which served in WWII as well as Vietnam and also recovered the Apollo 8 astronauts and space capsule. The USS Yorktown has carried thousands of men and lost more than 140 of them while in battle. Most were pilots who never returned from their missions.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: As Grant's final show is now just a case away, the team revisits an old favorite of his, Mt. Washington in Bretton Woods, New Hampshire. Not only was this the resort Grant honeymooned at 15 years ago but it later became a location that provided incredible evidence for the team. Now there are new claims and more areas and rooms open to the TAPS team.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: For Grant's last episode of Ghost Hunters, the TAPS team decides to stay close to home and investigate Jason and Grant's very own Spalding Inn. GHI investigated their Inn before, but this will be TAPS' first opportunity. The Spalding Inn was originally a summer home named Cherry Hill House that began taking in guests in 1865. It was renamed the Spalding Inn in 1926 when Randall and Anna Spalding took over.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On the first episode back since Grant made his announcement that he wasleaving, TAPS pushes forward focusing on the case on hand. They head to the University of Rhode Island to investigate a Fraternity house that has been experiencing paranormal activity for decades. Purchased in 1936, a former Governor once resided in the house, and there is a claim that his little girl, Abigail, fell to her death there.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to South Carolina, the winner of America's Hometown Ghost Hunters Contest, to investigate the renowned Old City Jail. This historical Jail was the final destination of America's first female serial killer, Lavinia Fisher. It's believed that Lavinia still lingers in the prison and it is up to TAPS to determine if that's true. This site has been around since 1738, when it was first used as a workhouse for slaves and a makeshift hospital for paupers, vagrants, and beggars.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads to Rutledge, Georgia to investigate Camp Rutledge, a family friendly camp, that is anything but friendly at night. The call to help comes from a frightened mother, Melissa, who has attended the camp since she was 17 yrs, and now has a daughter old enough to start vacationing at the campsite. Melissa has witnessed many unexplained paranormal things, and wants to make sure it's safe before she takes her daughter there.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS heads out on their first case since co-founder Grant Wilson left. This case takes them to New Orleans, Louisiana to investigate what's locally known as the Upstairs Fire at Jimani Lounge. The current owner, Jimmy Jr. was only 12 years old when an arsonist set fire to his father's club on June 24th, 1973. 32 men died trying to escape, but because these men were associated with the gay community, many bodies were never claimed, therefore, victims were never identified. Jimmy Jr.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: TAPS is called back to Alexandria, Louisiana to investigate the Alexandria Zoo, where the apparition of the longtime zookeeper and manager, Les has been seen. Les' longtime friend, Bill Hess called in TAPS after many longtime employees and friends noticed strange paranormal activity that reminded them of their dear friend. TAPS also introduces a new member, Ashley to the team and Jason promotes Adam to his new position, Investigator.

programme.title: Ghost Hunters
programme.desc: On this episode of Ghost Hunters, TAPS is asked to investigate Fort Ontario, a place that was the only location in America to provide sanctuary for Jewish refugees during World War II. Built in 1755, this fort first saw battle during the French and Indian war, and is no stranger to bloodshed. ...and phenomena.

programme.sub-title: Todo por amor; Viviendo en un storage

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Paola ayuda a chicos con tendencias suicidas, pero Jefri casi muere presuntamente incitado por ella. Para comprobar la infidelidad de su marido le pone pegamento y picapica a los condones.
programme.sub-title: Club de jóvenes suicidas; La picapica

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Jairo sufre un derrame cerebral y al salir del coma tiene una nueva orientación sexual. Consume unos hongos que le provocan alucinaciones y, al otro día, despierta con el clítoris mutilado.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El hijo de Carolina y Hugo es sordo, ella lo inscribe en clases de actuación, pero a escondidas del padre. También, Elizabeth sale del ejército y se obsesiona con la comida militar.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: July le paga a Santiago para que tramite su proceso migratorio, pero él se gasta el dinero y no hace nada. Accede a tener un trío con otro hombre y ahora su esposa está embarazada del invitado.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Natalia quiere regresar a Colombia para realizarse profesionalmente y le propone a su marido que cuide de sus hijos durante ese tiempo. Una madre le causó un daño irremediable a su hija.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Natasha busca al hombre que mató a su hermano y decide casarse con él para vengarse, sin imaginar que su plan tomaría otro rumbo. Una modelo es víctima de activistas fuera de control.
programme.sub-title: El asesino de mi hermano; Slow fashion

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Elizabeth confía en David para que sus hijos crucen la frontera, pero cuando el menor desaparece, ella pide la custodia del mayor. Andrea busca desalojar a su madrastra porque mató a su padre.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Isaac se llevó a la bebé de Andrea. Aunque lo acusan de secuestro, la responsabilidad recae en la madre. Merlissa busca la custodia de su sobrino, pero descubre que él pide dinero en semáforos.
programme.sub-title: Secuestro sobre ruedas; No hay vuelta atrás

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: En Internet, circula un video de Santiago en el baño gracias a una cámara oculta en la casa que alquiló. Por otro lado, Geovani y Nixon son pareja en un videojuego y se pelean por dinero.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Tiene ascendencia árabe y lo despiden porque sus rezos asustan al dueño de la empresa. Julián quiere terminar su relación con Lina porque cree que su pareja solo siente deseo por ella misma.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Andrés acusa a Gregory por racista, lo culpa de la deportación de su padre. María causa un accidente al conducir un auto de juguete bajo efectos del alcohol, su hermana la demanda.
programme.sub-title: No más indocumentados; Borracha manejando auto de juguete

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Cristopher es un hombre heterosexual, casado y con hijos, que siente la necesidad de vestirse de mujer. Carolina quiere tener sexo con Jorge para contagiarse de VIH, él cree que es una locura.
programme.sub-title: Me convertí en otra persona; Orgía VIH

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Manuela quiere someter a su madre a una cirugía experimental e implantar un chip en su cerebro. Eliana le pide matrimonio a la hija de Liliana a través de un video, pero con una soga al cuello.
programme.sub-title: Microchip para mi madre; O te casas o te mueres

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Daniela necesita un trasplante de corazón y su hija, con muerte cerebral, puede ser la donante; pero ella está embarazada y su pareja se opone. Anciana exige el divorcio por falta de atención.
programme.sub-title: A corazón abierto; A los 70 también se termina

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Dos hermanos gemelos demandan a su madre porque no están de acuerdo con el uso que hace de sus redes sociales. La mujer publica fotos sexualmente comprometedoras y busca pareja en todos los sitios web de citas. Ariel aumentó el tráfico en las redes sociales del negocio de su esposa con una práctica que lleva a cabo con todas las chicas que conoce: les rocía aceite en las nalgas, lo cual atrae seguidores.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Nancy demanda a su hermana, por ella casi muere ahogada en una competencia de "pancakes". Héctor pide el divorcio y la custodia de sus hijas, su esposa lo traicionó con quien menos lo esperaba.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ashly contrató a un detective para aclarar el crimen de su esposo, pero ella lo resolvió y no quiere pagarle. Andrea culpa a Ruby y a Margy de la muerte de su padre y se disputan la herencia.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El hijo de Daniela y José es autista, tiene problemas de comunicación, pero si le dan su títere favorito no para de hablar, sus padres no saben qué hacer. Valentina sufre una enfermedad sexual.
programme.sub-title: Obsesión por títere; Semen en mi ojo

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Luis y Pierina tienen una hija con cáncer que no quiere someterse a quimioterapia. Además, Raúl padece el síndrome de Tourette y siente que su novia no lo comprende, solo lo hace sufrir.
programme.sub-title: Salvando a mi hija; Síndrome de Tourette

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Kelvin y Lorena son esposos y periodistas, ella lo envía a entrevistar a un narcotraficante, pero lo secuestran y casi muere. Sharon contrata a Pedro para que le pegue, pero todo sale mal.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Sufre de "bullying" y su madrastra la maquilla de muñeca diabólica para que huyan de ella. También, Danny es un usurero que da dinero en efectivo a cambio de usar las tarjetas de sus deudores.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ivandra queda colgada en una pared de escalar, cuando John deja de sujetarla, ella sufre daños en la muñeca. Los "Pony Play" se disfrazan y Pancho demanda a su esposa por maltrato animal.
programme.sub-title: Me dejaste colgada; Pancho y Romeo

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Luis le paga a la esposa de Joel para alquilar su vientre, pero ella cae en coma. Por otro lado, Hilario es un gaucho que maneja con mucha destreza las boleadoras y los tambores.
programme.sub-title: El bebé de la Bella Durmiente; Gaucho con las bolas grandes

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Orlando pide que su hermano Neifry deje de comportarse como su madre fallecida. Karla se infecta con una bacteria al hacerse un tratamiento de belleza con peces. Ahora exige que cierren el spa.
programme.sub-title: Poseído por mamá; Fish spa chupitos

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Carlos demanda a Marcela, su madrastra, para quitarle la custodia de su padre enfermo. Daniel sacrifica burros para preparar una gelatina capaz de sanar a su hijo, pero su esposa se opone.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Mía estudia periodismo en una academia de Artes y Letras; allí, ganó un concurso literario, pero la organizadora no quiere entregarle el premio porque sostiene que su historia, su vida como prostituta, no es un buen ejemplo para los demás estudiantes. Michel se disfrazó de Kory y se presentó a un examen con la intención de ayudarla, pero fue descubierto y ambos fueron sancionados y expulsados del sistema educativo.
programme.sub-title: Historia de una prosti; Estafa universitaria

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Le dan somníferos para que se mantenga delgada y pueda modelar. Practicaba sexo extremo con la hermana de su esposa, ella muere y le deja una herencia que no puede cobrar por estar involucrado.
programme.sub-title: Dormir o comer; Amor a la muerte

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Por presión de su esposo se hizo una operación gástrica, ahora siente que no es ella y quiere volver a engordar. Para cumplir con el testamento de su hermana deben sacrificar a un perro.
programme.sub-title: La gula; Entiérrame con el perro

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Henna y Miguel son incapacitados y quieren ser una familia independiente. Ivelis le exige compensación a Nicolás por publicar en las redes un video íntimo que la pone en ridículo.
programme.sub-title: Amor a lo Romeo y Julieta; Venganza del tigre

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Samuel y Chris son un dúo musical de niños, la mánager demanda a la mamá de uno de ellos porque no quiere firmar contrato con un show de televisión que les puede abrir las puertas del éxito.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Enrique no soporta la obsesión de su esposa por los cupones de descuentos, exige terapia psicológica. Anulan el contrato porque se besaron durante el experimento en el que fingían ser hermanos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Manuel tuvo una relación legal con una menor de edad, pero lo denuncian por entrar a su email sin permiso. Demandan a una profesora por resaltar lo peor de su alumno durante el funeral.
programme.sub-title: Entrenador embaraza a menor; Ofensa en el funeral

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Valentina y Juan tienen un programa radial sin audiencia, cuando él cambia el enfoque pone en peligro a los inmigrantes indocumentados. Los maniquíes semidesnudos de Cairo molestan a su vecina.
programme.sub-title: Radio de la frontera; Calientes, pero quietos

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Gabriel es un hombre lobo, algo que le fascina a Ana Lucía, su "roommate", quien lo acosa sexualmente. Lucy y su esposo hicieron un trío con un transexual, a quien él le deja su herencia.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Yasyky y su novio Yokymata viven su vida como si estuvieran dentro de una historia del universo Manga, el "Omegaverse". Como se sienten incomprendidos por la sociedad de E. UU. quieren irse a vivir a Japón, donde están más familiarizados con esta cultura, pero para ello necesitan la autorización de la madre del chico porque está incapacitado mentalmente. Mauricio quiere que su esposa deje las redes sociales porque están afectando su vida matrimonial, pero ella no puede despegarse de su teléfono.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Tayra se traga casi 10 mil dólares para protegerlos de unos traficantes, luego los evacua y paga sus gastos médicos. César pone al niño a lamer piernas de mujeres porque su saliva es curativa.
programme.sub-title: Dinero tragado, dinero cagado; Chupa piernas

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Turco le dice a Aurelio que tiene los planos del hospital, pero que no tienen muchas opciones para liberar a don Cleto sin sufrir algunas bajas. Mientras, él se entera del plan de su suegro.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le reclama a don Cleto el quererlo traicionar al aliarse con el Topo Galván, pero don Cleto lo niega. Doris le dice al general Jiménez que elimine a Marco, mientras Mejía salva a Leo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Marco le cuenta a Benítez la relación de Ramiro con el narco. El Turco convence al Topo Galván para ayudar a Aurelio y persuadir a los Villalobos. A Linares le dan de alta en el hospital.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le dice a Guadalupe que elimine al cardenal, pero alguien más lo hace por él. Matilde le dice a Alba que le dará un dinero a cambio de quedarse con el niño, ya que es hijo de Chacorta.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Doña Alba le dice al Turco que algo le pasa a Ximena. Alfonso autoriza que el artículo que hizo Eugenia con respecto a la muerte del cardenal se publique sin ninguna modificación.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio conoce a Leonor y comienza a coquetearle, aunque ella disimula con Alejandro. Marco Mejía visita a Ramiro en su oficina y le pregunta por Sonia: él le dice que está en Londres con su hija.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ximena pregunta a Aurelio si tuvo algo que ver con la muerte del cardenal. Él le promete a su esposa que va a cambiar, pero ella está decidida a escapar, por lo que le pide al Turco que la ayude.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica se arrepiente de haber golpeado al Triste y le pide disculpas, dice que Casillas no le volverá a ver la cara de idiota. Ximena visita a Cleto, y el Turco se entera del plan de Aurelio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Alba descubre a Ximena a punto de huir. Aurelio les dice al Cabo y a Tijeras que les dejará el territorio de los Robles y de los Villalobos. Cleto está preocupado, no sabe nada del cargamento.
programme.sub-title: Esta vida no es para mí

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Turco le declara su amor a Ximena, y ella está dispuesta a dejar a Aurelio, pero él se despierta y nota su ausencia. Leonor dopa a Alejandro para que no se sobrepase con ella.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio está angustiado, le pide a su gente que suspendan todo y se dediquen a localizar a Ximena. El Topo Galván le propone a Óscar Cadena asociarse en los túneles que tiene a disposición.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ximena decide regresar cuando Alba le cuenta que su padre está en terapia intensiva. Benítez le agradece al general Jiménez el haber detenido a don Cleto y darles un duro golpe a los carteles.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio golpea a su esposa y le dice que no podrá salir de la casa sin su permiso. Leonor queda preocupada al saber que Casillas descubrió su arma. Marco le ofrece a Ximena que ayude a Cleto.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Pollo le cuenta al Topo Galván que don Cleto tuvo un infarto. Cabo se deprime por lo que pasó con Mónica. Víctor toma a Matilde por la fuerza, mientras Aurelio se mete en el cuarto de Leo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Chacorta le pregunta a Heriberto si le gusta Matilde. Ponte y Orejas descubren que el Letrudo es el mismo general Jiménez. Leonor le asegura a Mejía que el Letrudo estuvo en la hacienda.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Turco le dice a Aurelio que tiene los planos del hospital, pero que no tienen muchas opciones para liberar a don Cleto sin sufrir algunas bajas. Mientras, él se entera del plan de su suegro.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Marco Mejía le enseña a Benítez la grabación donde se demuestra que el general Jiménez Arroyo hace tratos con Casillas. Aurelio llama al Cabo y a Tijeras para que maten al Letrudo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Marco Mejía les dice a Eugenia y a Alfonso que confirmó que Jiménez Arroyo es la persona del Gobierno aliada con el narcotráfico. Aurelio se siente dueño de todo el negocio. Leo visita a Ponte.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Topo Galván le dice al Pollo que se aliará con Mónica porque va a necesitar los contactos colombianos que ella tiene. El Turco se entrevista con Randy y le pide un par de favores.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El general Jiménez le dice a Marco que está dispuesto a hablar con el juez que le sea asignado, pero con la condición de que le den inmunidad a su esposa. Ramiro necesita localizar a Doris.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas se ve obligado a contarle a Mónica que mató a don Cleto Letrán, mientras Irina no se controla. Alba aconseja a Heriberto que no siga los pasos de Aurelio porque no le hace nada bien.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Eugenia se entera de que Alejandro Negrete estuvo en el rancho de los Casillas. Aurelio llama a Mejía y le advierte que va en camino al periódico, cuando lee el artículo que su novia escribió.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio secuestra a Eugenia y se la lleva a una bodega. Heriberto está muy angustiado por el artículo publicado en el periódico sobre la desaparición de Alejandro Negrete.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Turco le niega a Ximena que Heriberto está ligado a la desaparición de Negrete, y ella le reclama a Chacorta. Alfonso llega a la bodega donde tienen a Eugenia: no puede creer lo que pasó.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio acusa a Mónica de delatarlo. Chacorta aconseja al Turco andarse con cuidado con Casillas porque es capaz de hacer cualquier cosa, ya que no tuvo reparos en asesinar a don Cleto.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio y Mónica escapan juntos de la casa de seguridad. Ochoa encuentra una bodega con cocaína. Ponte halla una computadora, y Leonor descubre una gran cantidad de documentos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio llega al hotel donde se hospeda Mónica, y ella tiembla al verlo. El Turco le pide a Chacorta que se deshaga del cuerpo de Miss Sinaloa, ya que Marco Mejía viene en camino.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Marco Mejía le hace entrega a Ximena de los resultados de la autopsia realizada a Cleto Letrán, y le dice que está convencido de que fue Aurelio Casillas quien lo asesinó.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Ximena se presenta en el cuarto del Turco y le dice que quiere estar con él. El Cabo está dispuesto a recuperar la confianza de los Casillas. Leonor se defiende del fuerte ataque de Parra.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Cuando ella quiere deshacerse de su embarazo, Heriberto y Matilde son secuestrados en Colombia. Leonor le dice a Ponte que deben investigar al Turco, hombre de confianza de Aurelio Casillas.

programme.desc: Aurelio invita al Cabo a San Luis Potosí para eliminar a Colmenares, pero la relación es muy tensa entre ellos. Heriberto negocia con los secuestradores, y Matilde admira su valentía.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Turco llega a tiempo para salvar al Cabo de la ira de los Casillas, y les entrega los resultados de ADN de Tijeras como prueba de fidelidad. Chacorta sorprende a Matilde en Colombia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio llega al hotel para evitar que Ximena escape, donde se enfrenta al Turco por su engaño. Mejía le pide a Benítez que no le diga al presidente sobre sus sospechas del asesinato de Colmenares.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El presidente Benítez le dice a Marco Mejía que lo respalda y que jamás negociará con criminales. Aurelio espera una respuesta. Chacorta lleva a Matilde al hospital, y Heriberto se pone muy mal.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio invita a comer a Ximena, pero el Cabo y sus hombres llegan hasta el restaurante donde él está y se presenta una balacera. Chacorta se venga de Heriberto al saber de su relación con Matilde.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Casillas intenta llevarse a Ximena al extranjero, pero ella logra desarmar a uno de los hombres de Aurelio y lo amenaza. Doña Alba no acepta irse con él, y le canta las verdades en su cara.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio regresa a México y se lleva una sorpresa cuando llega a la bodega, por lo que decide cambiarse el rostro. El Cabo le dice al Chema que él se encarga de encontrar a Casillas con ayuda de Irina.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio Casillas se somete a cirugía estética, pero el procedimiento se complica y Heriberto pierde el control. Rutila le miente a Ximena por temor al Turco: le dice que extraña a su padre.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Todos creen que Aurelio Casillas ha muerto en una sala de operaciones. Sin embargo, la muerte que tanto impactó al mundo del narco mexicano es, en realidad, una mentira de quien busca venganza.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos

programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - The Navarino Challenge

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Diane explores everything from beguiling mastiha, to the local pasta to unique tomatoes, dangling like giant rubies against the renowned geometric patterns on medieval houses of Pyrgi. The flavors of historic Chios inspire her to cook up a succulent chicken and quince dish and an easy traditional black eyed pea salad with Mastiha vinaigrette.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Tasty Teardrops And Tomatoes: Chios

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Naxos is famed for the quality of its meats, its array of cow's milk and sheep-and-goats' milk cheeses and for its potatoes. Diane heads from the shore straight to a remote mountain hideaway with Alexis in tow, where two local cooks await them with a feast of stuffed lamb, potatoes, and a unique skillet pumpkin-onion pie.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Naxos: Meat & Potatoes Like You Never Had'em

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Near the historic Bay of Navarino, blanketed by olive, citrus trees and home to historical culinary artifacts unearthed in prehistoric clay tablets at Pylos, Diane cooks with two village ladies, making a local pork and fig dish, and olive-oil fried bread. Inspired by the cornucopia of olive oil, oranges and other local delicacies, she cooks up a Messinian meal.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - A Meal In Messinia

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: The second-largest Greek island and an hour from Athens, Diane heads out in search of mushrooms with a local mushroom forager and cultivator. They cook a favorite local recipe "kritharoto," mushrooms with orzo. Diane makes three delectable dishes with mushrooms, wine and local ingrediants, inspired by the flavors of this nearby "secret" land.
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Evia - An Island Hiding In Plain Sight

programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Barcelona: Gaudi, Gin And Gambas

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals

Then it's off to Athen's Central Market to buy Retsina at a famous tavern for a rooftop mezze party in the shadow of the Acropolis. Back at home, Sara uses canned sardines for a quick and easy pantry taco.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Under The Acropolis

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals
programme.desc: Sara kicks off with a street food tour in Rome led by American Ex Pat Katie Parla. Then, they perform a Roman hat trick - three pastas starting with the same delicious base: Gricia made with guanciale transforms into Amatriciana by adding tomatoes or Carbonara by adding eggs. In her own kitchen, Sara makes baked penne with prosciutto and Fontina cheese.
programme.sub-title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Essential Pastas of Rome

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets

If you start to lick the screen don't panic...

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets

programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Barcelona

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets

programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Helsinki

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets

There is everything the Mediterranean island, so rich in agricultural traditions, has to offer. Street food here is a must, including dozens of roasted, salted, pickled, and fried specialties one can count on.
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Palermo

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets

Be it a vegan wurst or a tasty cheesecake, here the surprises never finish!
programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Freiburg

programme.title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets

programme.sub-title: Exploring Europe's Great Food Markets - In the Belly of Bergen

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: Coffee expert Joey Chase goes on a pilgrimage along an ancient Ethiopian trading route that starts with the modern latte art cafes in Addis Ababa, then through the coffee kingdom of Jimma to the 10,000+-year-old wild coffee Yayu Forest. Village elders share the age-old secrets of hand processing, fire-pit roasting, and brewing of beans followed by a traditional feast.

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: After sharing a first-ever taste of coffee in a remote Maasai village, followed by an exploration of the terrain with some new-found friends, Joey explores a grandiose coffee estate in Mt. Kenya. He then jousts with coffee buyers in Nairbobi's auction house and experiences the hand sorting and elaborate tasting of over 100 distinctive coffees in a British Tudor-style plantation cottage.

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: Touting the practicality of gondola travel, Joey explores the canals of Venice and discovers the oldest coffee shop in Europe. The trail to classic Italian espresso leads from Illy Coffee near the high-fashion metropolis of Trieste to the medieval town of Scarperia where espresso machines are manufactured. Florence boasts a famous barista who prepares a masterful farewell espresso.

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: Bob Marley's son Rohan takes Joey on a journey from the streets of Kingston to the peaks of the Blue Mountains. From waterfall plunges and grazing tropical fruits on Rohan's farm to roasting the smoothest coffee on earth and enjoying a Jamaican feast that ends with a Marley-hosted jam session, Joey discovers the pulse of Jamaica through the lens of Marley Coffee.

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: The pursuit of the sweetest "honey" coffees on earth unleashes an adventure that includes "coffee monkeys", crocodiles, toucans, an exploration of the active crater of Volcan Poas, and surfing on the coast with a coffee farmer. The Costa Rican paradise reveals a uniquely artistic approach toward colorful honey coffees stored like wine and served just in time for a classic "coffee sock" brew.

programme.title: Chasing Coffee
programme.desc: Following an excursion to the extremely remote Gnobe Bugle Village, Joey Jeep-treks the terrain from the top of Volcan Baru. The search for coffee known to cost $1,000 per pound leads Joey to the eclectic town of Boquete, a plunge-worthy volcanic river-filled-crevasse, and awe-inspiring Gesha coffee farms with more rainbows and hummingbirds than one could possibly imagine.

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm
